TODAY, 405 YEARS AGO!
On November 21, 1620, the pilgrims aboard the Mayflower signed the Mayflower Compact. This established the first european self-governing structure in the land that would ultimately become the United States.
The agreement helped the settlers maintain order, cooperate for survival, and establish a tradition of self-rule that later influenced colonial assemblies and  ultimately, the foundations of the United States of America.
